title: Export a floor plan to DWG and hand the file to the user
task: Give a consultant a DWG of a plan: build or find the ViewPlan inside a block, then between blocks call Document.Export(folder, name, viewIds, DWGExportOptions) into Connector.ExportsDirectory and Connector.Publish the file so the user can fetch it.

pitfalls.symptom: script-target-must-not-be-modifiable when Document.Export is called inside Connector.WithTransaction.
pitfalls.cause: Export commits its own transaction and refuses a document that is modifiable (has a transaction open).
pitfalls.fix: Call Export at top level between blocks (step 2); create or edit the view in a block before it.

pitfalls.symptom: Export returns true but the expected file is not there.
pitfalls.cause: Revit derives the file name from the view when several views are exported, or the folder is not writable.
pitfalls.fix: Export into Connector.ExportsDirectory and check the actual file name (step 3).
